name: Arihant Superstructures Ltd
title: Arihant Superstructures Ltd - 506194 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real estate developer with Q4 revenue Rs 181 cr (+18.5% YoY) and FY26 pre-sales Rs 977 cr, but no capacity or supply discipline evidence; margin pressure and rising debt (net debt/equity 1.81x) with FCF negative for four years.

capex.quote: we should do a CAPEX of around 75 crores for these two assets

triggers.label: Avg realisation Rs/sq ft 6,082 → 7,769 (+27%)
triggers.quote: reflecting a year-on-year increase of 27% in the average price achieved

triggers.label: EBITDA margin FY27 guided 25%-27%
triggers.quote: we expect in this FY27 to increase our EBITDA margin and take it to 25%-27% range

triggers.label: World Villas velocity slowed, 4 villas in Q4
triggers.quote: this quarter only 4 villas are sold

triggers.label: Operating cash flow negative four years
triggers.quote: the operating cash flow has been negative for 4 consecutive years

guidance.quote: we expect to grow by 25% to 30% CAGR
It will go upwards of 2,000 very easily
jump forward from the 500-550 crores top line to around Rs. (+700) crores this year
we intend to spend around (+400) crores in construction this financial year
I think next financial year onwards, we should turn free cash flow positive

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow four years running
red_flags.quote: the operating cash flow has been negative for 4 consecutive years

red_flags.label: Unit-level velocity slowed; RERA-to-saleable area conversion inflates area
red_flags.quote: we converted the RERA carpet area, which was existing in the World Villa and Town Villa project to saleable area

red_flags.label: Promoter unsecured loans Rs 361 cr repayable when enabled
red_flags.quote: the loan is from the promoters, it's payable when enabled

evasions.quote: So, I think it can increase by another 50 odd crores from here on.
I will tell my sales team to come back to you on this.
